heading: Definition
lead: For purposes of this chapter, “State” includes the District of Columbia and the territories and possessions of the United States.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15210136:4113.Nov. 14, 1988, Pub. L. 100–655, § 114, 102 Stat. 3852. The words “the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico” are omitted as included in “the territories and possessions of the United States”.
